Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma score 5 and 7 in potentially their last match on New Zealand soil 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma score 5 and 7 in potentially their last match on New Zealand soil
 short by Anmol Sharma / 08:20 am on Sunday, 15 November 2026 Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma scored 5(7) and 7(13), respectively, in India's fifth ODI against New Zealand at Mount Maunganui on Sunday. Both batters were dismissed by Matthew Fisher. With both cricketers now playing only ODIs internationally, the match could potentially mark their last appearance on New Zealand soil. Notably, both were dismissed for ducks in the fourth ODI. read more at Cricinfo Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
